beschreibung:
Baroque Residence at the Gateway to the Zillertal

The stately Schloss Rotholz is situated in the municipality of Strass im Zillertal at the foot of the Unterinntal slopes. Founded in the 16th century by the lords of Rottenburg, the estate was redesigned in Baroque style at the end of the 18th century by the Grafen Tannenberg.

Tradition and Agricultural Education Center

For many decades, the castle grounds have housed the renowned Landwirtschaftliche Landeslehranstalt Rotholz, complete with its own cheesemaking school. The distinctive main building with its symmetrical façades and corner oriels continues to shape the region's cultural landscape to this day.
